title: Waiver of examinations.
officialText:
Where the application is on behalf of a city agency, the commissioner may waive the examination requirement if the applicant has sufficient experience qualifications of a type and duration comparable to those set forth in section 28-430.3 of this section as determined by the commissioner.

(L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
